Using \(x=r\cos\theta\) and \(y=r\sin\theta\),

\[
V(r,\theta)=\frac12 kr^2+\frac32 kr^2\cos^2\theta
=\frac12 k(x^2+y^2)+\frac32 kx^2.
\]

Thus,

\[
V(x,y)=2kx^2+\frac12 ky^2
=\frac12 m\omega_x^2x^2+\frac12 m\omega_y^2y^2.
\]

Matching coefficients gives

\[
\omega_x^2=\frac{4k}{m}\quad\Rightarrow\quad \omega_x=2\sqrt{\frac km},
\qquad
\omega_y=\sqrt{\frac km}.
\]

The two-dimensional harmonic-oscillator spectrum is therefore

\[
E_{n_x,n_y}
=\hbar\omega_x\left(n_x+\frac12\right)
+\hbar\omega_y\left(n_y+\frac12\right)
=\left(2n_x+n_y+\frac32\right)\hbar\sqrt{\frac km},
\]

where \(n_x,n_y=0,1,2,\ldots\).

Answer: D
